# Aegraph rules

     when this file is stale. Refresh it with `bazel run //pass/aegraph:aeg_rules_refresh`. -->

Every rule the engine can run, per group (a group is a `rules/<group>.rules` file; a hand-written rule joins the
group named by its file's `AEG_RULE_GROUP`). Inside a group the rules are listed in the order the engine tries them:
priority descending, then name. `simplify` replaces the class, `alt` unions an alternative that extraction may keep,
`choice` is an alt carrying a `?` assignment.

Proof tier: `bv-swept` = the rule's instances are LEC-checked by `aeg_prove_<group>_smoke` over widths
{1,2,3,8,16,65} (bounded evidence, not a proof for all widths); `native-unverified` = hand-written, covered by the
union-invariant fuzz and an equiv fixture only; `none` = the rule opted out.

| `mux_bool_const_arms` | simplify | 30 | Mux | native-unverified | mux.cpp:25 | Mux(s, 1, 0) = EQ(s, 0), and Mux(s, 0, 1) = s for a 0/1 selector (a wider selector must keep the Mux: it reads any nonzero value as true). |
| `mux_const_arm_logic` | simplify | 30 | Mux | native-unverified | mux.cpp:41 | One constant 0/1 arm over a 0/1 value is plain logic: s ? 1 : f = s \| f      s ? 0 : f = !s & f      s ? t : 0 = s & t      s ? t : 1 = !s \| t Only over a computed (e-node) value: a latch Q is a leaf here, and `s \| q` on a latch's hold arm would be a Q -> D path through logic. |
| `mux_sel_arm` | simplify | 30 | Mux | bv-swept | mux.rules:4 | Mux(s, 0, s) = s: s ? s : 0. |
| `mux_sel_not` | simplify | 30 | Mux | bv-swept | mux.rules:10 | Mux(EQ(c, 0), f, t) = Mux(c, t, f) for a 0/1 value c: the selector reads the condition itself and the arms swap. |
